title: A triangle classifier
description:
Say what kind of triangle three sides make.

```
Sides: 3 4 5
scalene, right-angled
Sides: 2 2 2
equilateral
Sides: 1 2 10
not a triangle
```
hints: Sort the three values first with a few swaps so `c` is the longest; then only one triangle check is needed: `a + b > c` (lesson 1.05).
Use `&&` and `||` for the kinds: equilateral `a == b && b == c`, isosceles `a == b || b == c`.
requirements: Not a triangle when any side is 0 or less, or one side is at least the sum of the other two.
Equilateral, isosceles or scalene; add `, right-angled` when `a² + b² = c²` for the longest side `c`.
stretch: Print the area with Heron's formula and `sqrt`.
